decision_question: Should THIN_CENTRED_HYBRID_V03 be selected as the successor Project semantic/control architecture target for the next governed implementation and migration-qualification stages?

d1.amendment: realization_initialization is an ordered zero-to-many collection

ACCEPT.meaning: Select THIN_CENTRED_HYBRID_V03 as the successor architecture target for the next governed implementation/migration-qualification stage.
immediate_effects: Specification 028 remains operational authority until separately superseded
dependent DRPs remain paused until separately routed

AMEND.meaning: Do not select the candidate yet. State the architecture changes required, then freeze a revised candidate before another decision.

REJECT.meaning: Do not select THIN_CENTRED_HYBRID_V03. Return the architecture to redesign/recomparison.

recommendation_basis: The pre-owner discriminator program required by Research 477 is complete.
D-3 passed its frozen dependency proof.
D-2 achieved independent 14/14 semantic agreement across extended lineage cases.

D-1 exercised a real end-to-end governing event; its only independent-evaluator mismatch was an under-specified collection container, which is reconciled prospectively in V03 and aligns with D-2 N:M semantics.
No materially better whole architecture was identified in the final comparative critique.
non_effects_of_acceptance: Does not authorize physical file/folder migration.
Does not imply untouched confirmation has passed.
Does not resolve concrete implementation/storage/UI choices.
